title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - VehicleAuthorisationCase
description:
Vehicle APIS Case (era:VehicleAuthorisationCase's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): The process allowing the vehicle authorisation for placing in service (APIS).

This authorisation case supported a Vehicle Application for APIS and was determined by exactly one set of Vehicles and if available a VehicleType.

For the Authorisation as per EU 2018/545, use era:VehicleTypeAuthorisationCase, which covers all authorisations types under that legislation. Inherits attributes from era:Case (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleAuthorisationCase'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

areaOfUse.description: Property. (32) ‘area of use of a vehicle’ means a network or networks within a Member State or a group of Member States in which a vehicle is intended to be used; Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

authorisingMemberState.description: Property. Indicates the member state where a vehicle type has been authorized. Not to be confused with Area Of Use. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

configDependentCondition.description: Relationship. This property is used to link a vehicle type with its restrictions, through the authorisation case(s) Target type (Compliance) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

typeRegistrationMethod.description: Property. The registration method which was used in the vehicle type authorisation process. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Vehicle Type Registration Methods' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/vehicle-type-registration-methods/VehicleTypeRegistrationMethods), 12 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

concerns.description: Relationship. holds as material content, constitutes, embodies the material components of the Scope. Target type (Scope) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

constitutes.description: Relationship. forms a complete, independent, possibly sole part of a request Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

permissionType.description: Property. the detailed process which constitutes this Case's permission conditions Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

status.description: Property. the status of the Request, or constituting Case(s), as it is being treated by the PermittingBody Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.
